\label{fig:twoschemas}
\Description{Two panels compare accuracy after non-breaking updates, targeted structural changes, and outside-coverage changes. Synthetic retail: No-Memory, Traj-Retrieve, Traj-PromptVerify, Metric-Schema, Metric-Relearn, Maint-DefLevel, and MAVRA achieve 32, 59, 63, 60, 65, 71, and 72 percent on structural changes, respectively. Their outside-coverage accuracies, equally averaging unit scaling and backup copies, are 36, 55, 67, 60, 51, 51, and 51 percent. TPC-H evaluates only No-Memory, Traj-Retrieve, and MAVRA: structural accuracy is 60, 55, and 75 percent; outside-coverage accuracy is 70, 59, and 68 percent. Vertical lines show run ranges, not confidence intervals. Held-out, individual unit and backup, and all-setting results are retained in the artifact's supplementary table.}
